commit_message: Add ADR 0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
## ADR 0126 implementation

This Draft PR integrates the validated Timeline foundation from #90 onto current `main` without merging or force-applying the stale branch. Follow-up Dispatcher requests on this same branch will complete runtime composition, Timeline Player / Project Rust control, shared Editor/CLI/MCP authoring parity, Sequencer UI, persistent Scene View preview, tests, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation required by ADR 0126.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged until the Definition of Done and required validation are satisfied.
